中段构成让视线从胸口流向手、从手流向头发、从头发流向脸。头发、裙摆、外套下摆、丝带、蕾丝、饰品等参考图像中存在的可动元素，比身体动作慢半拍柔和摆动。角色微微扭转肩部，将重心轻轻放在一条腿上，采取能自然优美展现体型和服装剪影的站姿。不是夸张表演，优先采用如时尚影像般精致的身体展示方式。中段某处加入胸上近景镜头，让脸和眼睛以偏正面方向清晰呈现。

结尾可使用双臂上举的流程，但镜头不拉远展示全身。在可见到大腿的中景与胸上近景之间维持，同时使用稍快的斜向上移、轻微环绕、短促推近，优美地展示肩部、手臂、胸口、腰部、大腿、头发散开、主要装饰。最后以脸部奖励为最优先。镜头自然从胸上推近到半身特写，角色以偏正面方向看向镜头。最后一刻，角色以镜头视线，展现符合该人物的自然小微笑。眼睛明亮，脸颊柔和放松，嘴角高雅地微笑。最后在镜头视线笑容最迷人的瞬间切出。

extra-b0353a6ac6d7.en:
High-quality anime footage.

Refer to the character in the source reference image and strictly maintain them as the same person throughout the entire video. Use the reference image only to maintain the character's face, contours, eye shape, iris color, hairstyle, hair color, hair volume, costume, ornaments, physique, body proportions, silhouette, atmosphere, and character color. Do not reproduce the reference image's own background, room, furniture, pose, expression, angle of view, or framing. Only the expression, gaze, mouth area, pose, breathing, and natural swaying of hair and costume may change. Mixing of features, averaging of the face, alteration of hairstyle, alteration of hair color, costume swapping, disappearance of ornaments, body type changes, becoming a different person, cloning, and addition of extra people are prohibited.

Throughout the entire video, consistently maintain the high-quality anime expression best suited to the character in the reference image. Base it on a delicate hand-drawn anime style, with thin lines, elegant colors with a sense of transparency, and soft, luxurious anime-look shading for skin, hair, cloth, and ornaments. If the atmosphere of the reference image is bright, lean toward fresh; if calm, lean toward elegant and quiet. However, keep the art style itself consistent, and do not use thick lines, low-budget TV anime style, semi-realism, live-action style, plastic CG style, excessive 3D feel, or mixed art styles.

Fix the location throughout the entire video as a bright outdoor luxury resort space. Maintain white architecture, blue sky, an open terrace, parasols, distant palm trees, and soft daytime natural light as the basic composition. The background should be fresh and bright, with light blur and depth so the person looks like the main subject. Maintain the structure of the location, the setting of an outdoor resort, white architecture, blue sky, terrace, parasols, and palm trees. On top of that, naturally adjust only the parasols, cushions, flowers, table accessories, decorative cloth, reflected light, and background accent colors to match the reference image's character color, costume color scheme, decorative motifs, and personality atmosphere. The background should devote itself to supporting the character and should not stand out more than the person. Do not make it a different location.

This video is not a strict reproduction of the original video, but rather a redesign into SNS-worthy camera work that shows the body attractively while maintaining the same fresh atmosphere. Strict reproduction of expressions is not necessary, but the face should be clearly readable throughout the entire video. Include multiple face rewards where the face, eyes, cheeks, and mouth area are properly visible. Match the expression to the character's inherent atmosphere, centering on a natural, soft gaze, a slight smile, a little shyness, or a modest, calm smile.

The video begins with a medium shot that shows up to the thighs. The character faces slightly in a three-quarter direction, in a composition where the legs, waist, chest area, shoulders, flow of hair, and main costume ornaments can be read at once. The camera enters from the start with a slightly energetic, smooth forward movement and diagonal movement, tracing pleasantly from bottom to top so that the gaze flows over the thighs, waist, chest area, shoulders, and face. However, do not leave the face behind; secure time where the face and eyes are clearly visible.

The character naturally raises both hands from below. The hands do not hide the face, and rise while passing in front of the thighs, in front of the waist, and in front of the chest area. The fingertips open softly and are not tense. The camera combines slightly faster sliding, light push-ins, and shallow orbiting in accordance with that movement, showing the body lines, costume structure, ornaments, and flow of hair one after another. When the hands pass near the lens, a light foreground blur may be created, but the face, eyes, cheeks, and mouth area must always be readable. Do not hide the face with the hands for a long time.

The camera is not fixed frontally; it quickly and shallowly orbits left and right as if licking across the front of the character, showing the thighs, waist lines, chest area design, shoulders, nape of the neck, profile, flowing hair, and costume ornaments with good tempo. It has momentum but is not too rough, maintaining elegance. Occasionally look up from a slightly lower viewpoint to beautifully show the length of the legs and the line connecting the thighs to the waist. As necessary, instantly move in from a medium shot that shows up to the thighs to a close-up above the chest, and then return to up to the thighs. Create an SNS-worthy rhythm through changes in camera speed.

In the middle section, compose it so that the gaze flows from the chest area to the hands, from the hands to the hair, and from the hair to the face. Movable elements present in the reference image, such as hair, skirt hem, coat hem, ribbons, lace, and accessories, sway softly half a beat behind the body's movement. The character slightly twists the shoulders, lightly places weight on one leg, and takes a stance where the body shape and costume silhouette naturally look beautiful. Prioritize a refined way of showing the body like a fashion video, rather than big acting. Somewhere in the middle section, include a shot closer than the chest area and clearly show the face and eyes from a near-frontal angle.

In the final section, a flow of raising both arms upward may be used, but the camera pulls back and does not show the whole body. While maintaining between a medium shot that shows up to the thighs and a close-up above the chest, use a slightly faster diagonal rise, light orbiting, and short push-ins to beautifully show the shoulders, arms, chest area, waist, thighs, spread of hair, and main ornaments. At the end, prioritize the face reward above all. The camera naturally moves in from above the chest to a bust-up, and the character looks toward the camera from a near-frontal angle. At the final moment, the character looks at the camera and shows a natural small smile befitting that person. The eyes are bright, the cheeks soften, and the mouth area smiles elegantly. End at the moment when that camera-facing smile looks most attractive.

Overall, the camera does not move slowly and observantly; in order to capture the person attractively, it follows slightly fast, smoothly, with good tempo, and pleasantly. Make it fresh and elegant, slightly fashion PV-like, and a bright, refined, SNS-worthy video.

No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermarks, no extra people, no clones, no face collapse, no changes in eye shape or iris color, no multiplication of hands, arms, or fingers, no costume alteration, no disappearance of ornaments, no hairstyle alteration, no hair color alteration, no body type changes, no ending with a full-body pull-back, no hand movements that hide the face for a long time, no camera that stops abruptly, no stiff standing poses, no background location changes, no mixed art styles.

创作一段30秒电影感照片级写实的晨间日常视频，全片始终是同一位年轻成年女性。

角色锁定：
每个镜头都是同一位女性，面部身份一致，相同的脸型、相同的眼睛、相同的鼻子、相同的发型、相同的发色、相同的肤色、相同的身体比例。自然有吸引力的外观，真实的皮肤质感，柔和的晨间表情。

场景1——醒来（0–5秒）：
柔和的金色晨光透过窗户照进一间舒适现代的卧室。她在床上慢慢醒来，自然地坐起身，望向窗户。平静安宁的晨间氛围，电影感镜头运动，真实光照。

场景2——窗景（5–9秒）：
她走向窗户，轻轻向外望去。透过窗户展示美丽的晨间街景：温暖的阳光、安静的住宅街道、微风中轻轻摇曳的树木、宁静的氛围。镜头短暂展示窗外景色，然后回到她的脸。

场景3——穿鞋（9–14秒）：
她坐在入口附近，穿上她那双相同的干净白色运动鞋。她的手和鞋子的特写，然后是她站起来的的中景。保持服装和角色完全一致。

场景4——梳头（14–18秒）：
她站在浴室里，在镜子前自然地梳头。保持完全相同的发型、脸、服装和配饰。干净现代的浴室，柔和自然的晨光。

场景5——咖啡（18–23秒）：
她准备一杯热咖啡，在厨房窗边放松地喝一口。可见咖啡冒出的热气，温暖的阳光，舒适的电影感氛围。保持她的外观和服装完全一致。

场景6——出门（23–27秒）：
她拿起米色单肩包，打开前门，走到外面宁静的晨间街道上。平滑的跟踪镜头从背后跟随她，然后移到她身旁。

场景7——最终行走画面（27–30秒）：
广角电影感镜头，同一位女性走在美丽的晨间街道上。她自然走远时清晰展示她的全套服装。温暖的金色阳光、树木、柔和阴影、宁静的城市氛围。以美丽的广角定场镜头结束。
